title: MenuCommandsIngestV1
description: Queue-only trigger contract (spec 11 §4.4, §5.2) that crosses the broker to the isolated menu-ingestion consumer (consumer 'menu.processor'). It instructs the worker to run the pipeline for an already-uploaded catalog: scan → (quarantine | extract → draft). Carries NO secrets, PAN, or transcript text (Inv-12); source_artifact_ref is an opaque tenant-scoped object-storage handle, never the artifact bytes or any credential.

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'menu.commands.ingest.v1' for this contract.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. All consumer-side writes are scoped to this tenant (Inv-13).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across all messages in the ingestion chain.

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause (nullable for synthetic/system-generated triggers).

catalog_id.description: Stable id of the vendor_catalogs row (status 'uploaded') this ingestion processes.

source_artifact_ref.description: Opaque tenant-scoped object-storage reference to the uploaded artifact (e.g. 's3://tenant/...'). NEVER the artifact bytes, a URL with credentials, or any secret (Inv-12).
